vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: The golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is unmaintained and unsafe by design.

statements.impact_statement: Only the packages argon2 and blake2b (password hashing) and md4 (NTLM sign-in of the LDAP client) of golang.org/x/crypto are compiled in, as vendor/modules.txt shows. The openpgp package is not imported, so its code is not part of dendronotes. govulncheck reports the finding at module level only.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4
vulnerability.description: deepmerge mergeObject() allows prototype poisoning of returned objects.

statements.impact_statement: deepmerge is used by @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte while the web interface is built. It is a build tool dependency and is not part of the shipped bundle, binary or image.
